Subject: Fwd: Prorate calc + VAT guidance (draft attached)

Vanessa / Ben — draft prorate attached. Key points from the calculation:
- Billing period: 2027-04-01 -> 2027-04-30 (30 days).
- Seat change effective 2027-04-10 (downgrade from 120 -> 95).
- Daily seat-rate (per seat): EUR 1.80 (example unit price from CH-2027-042 SOW).

Calculations (see attachment prorate_breakdown_Crescent.xlsx):
- Full-month charge (120 seats): 120 * 1.80 * 30 = EUR 6,480.00
- Used portion (120 seats from Apr1–Apr9 = 9 days): 120 * 1.80 * 9 = EUR 1,944.00
- Remainder billed at new quantity (95 seats from Apr10–Apr30 = 21 days): 95 * 1.80 * 21 = EUR 3,591.00
- Net billable for April (pro-rated mix): EUR 1,944.00 + EUR 3,591.00 = EUR 5,535.00
- Credit to be issued against original full-month invoice: EUR 6,480.00 - EUR 5,535.00 = EUR 945.00 credit

VAT treatment:
- If Crescent provides a valid VAT ID, apply reverse-charge (net zero VAT on Redwood invoice).
- If no VAT ID, apply Swedish VAT 25% on the net billed amount (EUR 5,535.00 * 25% = EUR 1,383.75).

Payment routing notes:
- SEPA payment is OK; provide SEPA IBAN and reference.
- If the original Apr invoice was charged to card and already settled, we will issue a credit note (to be applied to next invoice) and can also process a reversal to the card if requested — Stripe refunds may take 5–10 business days.

Attachments included: prorate_breakdown_Crescent.xlsx (line-level calc), draft_credit_note_TEMPLATE.pdf (internal).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
